subject: Activation blocked by anti-bot challenge - Acme Medical Supplies
messages:
From: Dana Ortiz <onboarding@acmemed.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmemed.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trouble completing supplier activation (Coupa)

Hi Stephanie,

We're trying to activate our supplier account through the Coupa invitation sent Friday, but every time our team follows the activation link it drops us into a CAPTCHA/anti-bot page. After completing the CAPTCHA, the portal returns a generic error page ("Request blocked - 403") or redirects us back to the same challenge. We've tried from multiple browsers and two different office IP ranges and see the same behavior.

Steps we've tried:
- Cleared cookies and tried incognito
- Tried on Chrome and Safari
- Attempted from home network and office VPN

Screenshot attached (acme-captcha-screenshot.png). Can you advise? We need to get this account live so we can receive our first PO next week.

Thanks,
Dana Ortiz
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Acme Medical Supplies
onboarding@acmemed.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ortiz <onboarding@acmemed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trouble completing supplier activation (Coupa)

Hi Dana —

Thanks for the clear repro and the screenshot. Sorry you're blocked; that anti-bot gate is kicking in unexpectedly for some IPs. Quick notes and an interim path to get you onboarded today: 

1) Temporary manual claim link (one-time): https://app.coupa.com/supplier/claim/manual-override/ACME-12345 (expires in 24 hours). Use that link and the org name "Acme Medical Supplies".

2) If the manual link fails, please upload the completed W-9 to this secure form or reply with the attachment and we can do a manual create on our side.

3) I'll loop in Ben and Karthik to look at rate-limiting/anti-bot thresholds for your IP ranges and the CAPTCHA config.

Attached a short guide that covers both the manual claim and the expected PO visibility steps (manual-onboard-instructions.pdf). If you can confirm when you try the link I'll promote the account to active and verify the first PO flow.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Trouble completing supplier activation (Coupa) — infra action

Stephanie / Karthik — forwarding Dana's report. Quick triage notes: 

- Logs show multiple 403 responses from our WAF to requests that presented a missing or incorrectly signed bot-token header. Suspect our CAPTCHA provider started stricter heuristics this weekend (likely automated update).
- Temporary mitigations: relax the CAPTCHA sensitivity for the Coupa claim endpoint and add Acme IP ranges to the allowlist. I've opened SUP-2314 to track (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-2314).

Karthik: can you add these IP ranges to the application allowlist and bump the rate-limiter for /supplier/claim/* for 24 hours? Once we confirm activation I'll revert the permissive rules.

Thanks — copying the original thread below.

—Ben
